name: COUPNCD
description: COUPNCD returns the date of the next coupon payment for a bond after the settlement date.
tldr: Calculates the next coupon date after the settlement date.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Number of coupon payments per year (1, 2, or 4).

basicExample.description: Next coupon date for a semi-annual bond
basicExample.explanation: Returns the date of the next coupon payment. Format the cell as a date to see the result.

advancedExamples.title: Format the result as a date
advancedExamples.explanation: Wraps the result in TEXT to display it as a date string.

howItWorks: COUPNCD uses the maturity date and frequency to calculate the coupon schedule and returns the first coupon date after settlement.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Basis affects date calculations in some edge cases.

commonErrors.cause: The result is a date serial number not formatted as a date.
commonErrors.fix: Format the cell as a date.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: COUPNCD works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between COUPNCD and COUPPCD?
faq.answer: COUPNCD returns the next coupon date. COUPPCD returns the previous coupon date.

faq.question: How do I display the result of COUPNCD?
faq.answer: Format the cell as a date or use the TEXT function.
